title: A bootstrap approach to prediction-powered inference
summary: Prediction-powered inference (PPI) refers to a two-level situation where the statistician observes a set of $(x,y)$ pairs and another set of $x$s with the responses $y$ missing. Also available is some independent background data from which a prediction rule $f(x)$ has been produced, perhaps by a machine learning algorithm; $f(x)$ approximates $E\{y\mid x\}$ but there is no guarantee of its accuracy for the situation at hand.
